focusTitle: Dead code: scripts, gates and config entries nothing reads
focus: Question 7: find scripts, functions, flags and config entries in scripts/, benchmark/ (not benchmark/reports/) and both packets that nothing calls, imports, tests or documents. Searches performed: walked every .py, .cjs, .js and .sh file in scripts/, benchmark/, sk-product-owner/ and sk-create-figjam/ except reports and vendored trees, extracted every top-level def, function and UPPER constant, and counted code-only occurrences across all .py/.cjs/.js/.sh files in the repository; then grepped every runtime script basename across the whole tree excluding specs, export, reports and vendored; then grepped each registry config key in this repository and in .skilled.

findings.label: No dead code file exists. All 31 runtime files across scripts/, benchmark/ and both packets are reached by a caller, a gate row or a documented manual command, and the symbol scan found no top-level function or constant with zero code references in any of the 21 files that hold definitions. The nearest misses are manual-only tools (the parity wrappers, the self-check and build-plugin), which are documented rather than dead. Fix: none. [SOURCE: AI Systems/Product Owner/benchmark/gates/run_gates.sh:41-54] [SOURCE: AI Systems/Product Owner/scripts/vendor-sync.py:383-402]

The generated plugin copy is stale by one line and nothing notices: claude-plugin/skills/product-owner/sk-product-owner/references/router-contract.md lacks the just-do-it branch the source added, while the other 324 files in that build copy are byte-identical. Every direct hub file compared equal, so the drift is exactly one edit made after the last build. Fix: rebuild the plugin and add the freshness check that would have caught it. [SOURCE: AI Systems/Product Owner/sk-product-owner/references/router-contract.md:343-346] [SOURCE: AI Systems/Product Owner/claude-plugin/skills/product-owner/sk-product-owner/references/router-contract.md:343-344]

scripts/build-plugin.py is called by nothing automated: no row in run_gates.sh, no Python test, no hook in the repository. Its only references are the root README, the .gitignore comment and its own docstring, and its --self-test is never run by a gate. That is why the stale plugin copy above can ship: the build that produces it is not part of any check. Fix: add a build-plugin freshness row to benchmark/gates/run_gates.sh. [SOURCE: AI Systems/Product Owner/benchmark/gates/run_gates.sh:41-54] [SOURCE: AI Systems/Product Owner/scripts/build-plugin.py:37-38] [SOURCE: AI Systems/Product Owner/README.md:806]

mode-registry.json declares three config entries nothing reads. toolSurface.bashAllowlist is an empty array on all four modes, toolSurface.workspaceWrites is a sentence on mcp-figma, and extensions.transport-axis.crossHubPairing is an empty object; grepping each key across every .py, .cjs, .js, .sh, .md and .json in this repository and in .skilled returns no consumer. They are declarations with no reader, so they cannot fail and cannot help. Fix: delete them or state which external consumer reads them. [SOURCE: AI Systems/Product Owner/mode-registry.json:13-19] [SOURCE: AI Systems/Product Owner/mode-registry.json:29-38] [SOURCE: AI Systems/Product Owner/mode-registry.json:145-160]

hub-router.json defaultResourceSemantics is read by no checker: the root-router contract reads the defaultResource array and rejects only a legacy path, and check_hub never opens the field. It is prose living inside a machine file, which is exactly where a stale sentence hides. Fix: move the sentence to SKILL.md or delete it. [SOURCE: AI Systems/Product Owner/hub-router.json:18-23] [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/sk-doc/sk-create-skill/scripts/lib/root-router-contract.cjs:31-35]

Two live surfaces are ungated rather than dead: the five benchmark/parity wrappers and route_contract.py --self-check. run_gates.sh deliberately omits both and says they run from benchmark/parity once a batch is committed, and the root README documents --self-check as a manual command. Recorded so a future cleanup does not delete them as unused, and so the omission stays visible. Fix: none, or add them to a committed-run gate. [SOURCE: AI Systems/Product Owner/benchmark/gates/run_gates.sh:29-32] [SOURCE: AI Systems/Product Owner/benchmark/parity/README.md:1-20] [SOURCE: AI Systems/Product Owner/README.md:700]

vendor-sync.py parses --package and a suppressed --root, and no caller passes either: the only automated call is the bare status row in run_gates.sh, and the README invokes pull and push with no flags. They are documented manual escape hatches rather than dead code, because both change what the command scans, so deleting them would remove capability rather than remove dead weight. Fix: none; keep and document. [SOURCE: AI Systems/Product Owner/scripts/vendor-sync.py:383-388] [SOURCE: AI Systems/Product Owner/benchmark/gates/run_gates.sh:47]

The differential corpus group named known-divergences is a dead label: behavior parity applies to every corpus input with no exception list, so the two entries in that group must now agree like any other, and the name describes history rather than a current exemption. Fix: rename the group to what it exercises. [SOURCE: AI Systems/Product Owner/benchmark/router/differential_corpus.json:1-10] [SOURCE: AI Systems/Product Owner/benchmark/router/differential.py:573-613]

ruledOut: Calling figjam_checks/fixtures.py dead because flow_check does not import it at module load: it is imported inside the self-test at line 211 and every planted model in it is used
Calling the five benchmark/parity wrappers dead: they are documented manual checks, and run_gates.sh explains why they are not in the automatic list
Calling route_contract.py --self-check dead: the root README documents it as a one-sample-per-layer smoke test
deadEnds: Searching for a zero-reference top-level function or UPPER constant in the 21 definition-bearing files: none was found, in code-only reference counting
Searching for a script basename with a single reference: every basename resolved to at least a caller and its own definition

edgeCases.ambiguous: Question 7 asks for code that nothing calls, imports, tests or documents; the split matters, so a documented manual tool is reported as ungated, not as dead
edgeCases.contradictory: The plugin copy is generated, and generated copies are excluded from the dead-code definition, but a stale generated copy is still a defect, so it is recorded under freshness rather than dead code
edgeCases.missing: No daemon or external advisor consumer could be inspected, so registry fields are called unread in this repository and in .skilled, not unread everywhere
edgeCases.partial: The symbol scan is lexical: it proves no name is unused, not that every branch is reachable

reflection.worked: Comparing the plugin build copy file by file against its sources turned a general freshness worry into one exact stale line, which no gate reports
reflection.failed: The first dead-code scan folded markdown into the reference count, so a function named only in a README looked live; rerunning on code only made the result trustworthy
reflection.differently: Check generated copies against their sources before scanning for unused symbols, because a stale copy is the defect a symbol scan cannot see

noveltyJustification: The iteration clears the dead-code question with a stated search and finds the real defect elsewhere: a one-line stale plugin copy, an ungated build script and four config entries with no reader.
